description: This file contains unit tests for the MediaKeys IPC callback functionality in the Rialto media client. It tests the forwarding of license requests, license renewals, and key status changes over IPC, as well as handling of invalid handles and unregistered sessions.

classes.name: RialtoClientMediaKeysIpcCallbackTest
classes.description: A test fixture class for testing the IPC callback handling in the Rialto media client, including setup and utility functions for creating events and managing key statuses.

methods.name: addPairsToKeyStatusVector
methods.description: Adds a specified number of key status pairs to the internal key status vector for testing.

methods.name: createLicenseRequestEvent
methods.description: Creates a mock license request event with preset data for testing.

methods.name: createKeyStatusesChangedEvent
methods.description: Creates a mock key statuses changed event with preset data for testing.
